'''Iker Álvarez de Eulate Molné''' (born 25 July 2001) is an Andorran professional [[footballer]] who plays as a [[Goalkeeper (association football)|goalkeeper]] for Spanish club [[Córdoba CF]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==Club career==
Álvarez represented [[Inter Club d'Escaldes]],<ref name="interview">{{cite news |last=López-Egea |first=Miquel |url=https://www.elperiodic.ad/entrevista/71045/lobjectiu-es-ser-porter-del-villarreal-i-acabar-jugant-a-la-primera-divisio |title=Iker Álvarez de Eulate, Porter del CD Roda i de la selecció sub-21: "L'objectiu és ser porter del Villarreal i acabar jugant a la Primera Divisió" |trans-title=Iker Álvarez de Eulate, Goalkeeper of CD Roda and the under-21 team: "The goal is to be Villarreal's goalkeeper and end up playing in the First Division" |work=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]] |date=3 April 2019 |access-date=28 March 2021 |language=ca |archive-date=4 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190404132953/https://www.elperiodic.ad/entrevista/71045/lobjectiu-es-ser-porter-del-villarreal-i-acabar-jugant-a-la-primera-divisio |url-status=dead }}</ref> [[FC Andorra]] and [[Club Gimnàstic de Manresa]] before joining [[Villarreal CF]]'s youth categories in 2017; he was initially assigned to affiliate club [[CD Roda]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.levante-emv.com/castello/2017/11/13/iker-alvarez-portero-calidad-altura-13846583.html|title=Iker Álvarez, portero de calidad y altura|trans-title=Iker Álvarez, goalkeeper of quality and height|publisher=[[Levante-EMV]]|language=es|date=13 November 2017|access-date=8 July 2023}}</ref> He returned to the structure of the ''Yellow Submarine'' in 2019, being assigned to [[Villarreal CF C|the C-team]] in [[Tercera División]].

Álvarez had his first call up for Villarreal's first team ahead of their [[UEFA Europa League]] last 16 second leg at home to [[FC Dynamo Kyiv]] on 18 March 2021.<ref name=kiev>{{cite news |title=Iker Álvarez, convocat amb el primer equip del Vila-real|trans-title=Iván Álvarez, selected for Villarreal's first team|url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/esports/2021/03/19/iker_alvarez_convocat_amb_primer_equip_del_vila_real_176683_1128.html|work=El Periòdic d'Andorra|access-date=21 December 2021 |date=19 March 2021 |language=Catalan}}</ref> He remained on the bench as second-choice [[Sergio Asenjo]] played in the 2–0 (4–0 aggregate) victory.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Gonzalo |first1=Juanjo |title=El Villarreal disfruta al son de Gerard Moreno|trans-title=Villarreal enjoy themselves to the sound of Gerard Moreno|url=https://www.lasprovincias.es/deportes/futbol/liga-europa/villarreal-dinamo-kiev-octavos-vuelta-20210318191334-ntrc.html?ref=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F |access-date=21 December 2021 |work=[[Las Provincias]] |date=18 March 2021 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

Álvarez first appeared with [[Villarreal CF B|the reserves]] on 9 May 2021, starting in a 4–3 [[Segunda División B]] home loss against [[FC Barcelona B]].  He was definitely promoted to the B's for the [[2021–22 Primera División RFEF|2021–22 season]], sharing the starting spot with [[Filip Jörgensen]] as the side achieved promotion to [[Segunda División]].

Álvarez made his professional debut on 29 August 2022, starting in a 3–0 away loss against [[Granada CF]]. On 21 June 2023, after establishing himself as a starter for the B-team after Jörgensen was constantly involved in first team duties, he renewed his contract until 2026.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://villarrealcf.es/iker-alvarez-2026/|title=Iker Álvarez 2026|publisher=Villarreal CF|language=es|date=21 June 2023|access-date=8 July 2023}}</ref>

On 18 June 2025, after failing to make a breakthrough in the first team, Álvarez moved to second division side [[Córdoba CF]] on a two-year deal.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://cordobacf.com/2025/06/18/el-cordoba-club-de-futbol-incorpora-al-guardameta-iker-alvarez/|title=El Córdoba Club de Fútbol incorpora al guardameta Iker Álvarez|trans-title=Córdoba Club de Fútbol sign goalkeeper Iker Álvarez|publisher=Córdoba CF|language=es|date=18 June 2025|accessdate=18 June 2025}}</ref>

==International career==
Álvarez made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 28 March 2021 in a [[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification]] match against [[Poland national football team|Poland]], losing 3–0 in [[Warsaw]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Un Lewandowski en racha firma un doblete en la victoria de Polonia sobre Andorra|trans-title=A Lewandowski on a hot streak scores a brace in Poland's victory over Andorra|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/mundial/polonia-vs-andorra/cronica/2021/03/28/6060ed5b22601dd1428b4585.html |access-date=21 December 2021 |work=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |date=28 March 2021 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Iker is the son of former footballer [[Koldo Álvarez]], who was capped for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] and later appointed as the team's [[Manager (association football)|manager]].<ref name="interview"/>
